conflict_checks.repository_search_note: The five source_record_key values were checked against the existing explicit review decisions. No match was found. Repository search found no existing food.grains.processed.nurungji candidate precedent. Current broad name rules can surface tea/snack candidates for 누룽지, but these products are bulk processed-rice foods and those candidates are product-form conflicts.

held_decisions.reason: Bulk glutinous-rice nurungji is a processed grain/rice food, not grain tea or a conventional savory snack.
Kimchi is a flavor/style attribute on a nurungji product; retain the common processed-rice product form.
Large-format cauldron nurungji clearly represents processed rice food rather than tea or snack.
Roasted laver is a flavor/addition; product form remains glutinous-rice nurungji.
Explicit white-rice nurungji is a processed rice product; rice variety is an attribute rather than a separate leaf.
